rule: Suggestions only. Choose a path before any implementation. The decision field is left blank for the owner.

rows.title: One NFL entry point; freeze the other namespaces
rows.why: 39 NFL namespaces publish contradictory numbers (RR-01, RR-02).
options: (a) Keep all namespaces as they are
(b) Freeze peers, make this namespace the entry point, and link each peer from a sitemap
(c) Delete peers
rows.decision_owner: Owner decision. No peer file is changed in this round.

rows.title: Price-data policy (decision SG-01)
rows.why: No official price source found. Market columns are blank (Q01).
options: (a) License an official or authorised price feed
(b) Accept blank market columns; publish own lines only
(c) Manual screenshots of third-party prices
rows.decision_owner: Owner decision. Option (c) has no verifiable provenance and conflicts with the brief's official-source rule.

rows.title: Add the 13 missing Week-10 finals to the results feed
rows.why: The feed reconciles for Weeks 1-9 and omits 13 Week-10 finals (RF-09).
options: (a) Add the 13 finals transcribed here, with their URLs
(b) Wait for the next scheduled refresh
rows.decision_owner: Owner of nfl-book to apply; the transcription and URLs are in data/official_reads_2026_11_18.json.

rows.title: Make the split table cover every completed game
rows.why: 13 completed games are in no split (RF-11).
options: (a) Freeze at 136 and name Week 10 as the first prospective window
(b) Extend the train set to all 150 games and re-run the walk-forward test
rows.decision_owner: Owner decision. Option (b) changes a pre-registered corpus and needs a new registration.

rows.title: Capture the injury report from Wednesday to kickoff, with hashes
rows.why: No daily series exists; Week 11 is not yet published (RF-15).
options: (a) Scheduled CI job (Wed-Sat) that fetches nfl.com and commits a hashed capture
(b) Manual capture by the owner
(c) Do not capture
rows.decision_owner: Owner approval for a scheduled job. The sandbox cannot reach nfl.com with curl; CI runners are a separate network path, to be confirmed.

rows.title: Replace the favorites-only control with a point-in-time one
rows.why: The current control uses future information (RF-16).
options: (a) Compute favorites from standings as of each pre-kickoff date
(b) Remove the favorites control
rows.decision_owner: Needs weekly standings captures, which S-05 style capture would supply.

rows.title: Make 'met' impossible without an artifact and an official source
rows.why: Round 2 downgraded 8 'met' rows that did not meet this test.
options: (a) Keep the round-2 rule in this namespace only
(b) Apply the same verifier across all namespaces
rows.decision_owner: Owner decision. The verifier here is engine/verify_r2.py.

rows.title: Link this namespace from the root landing page
rows.why: The root page does not link the NFL work.
options: (a) Add a root navigation entry (integration session)
(b) Leave it unlinked
rows.decision_owner: Logged in COORDINATION.md for the root-nav owner. Not edited here.

rows.title: Split COORDINATION.md into an archive and an active board
rows.why: COORDINATION.md is 569,341 bytes; claims and logs from many sessions sit in one file (RR-10).
options: (a) Move completed logs to COORDINATION-ARCHIVE.md
(b) Keep as is
rows.decision_owner: Owner decision. Changing the file is a separate task.

rows.title: Re-read the whole Week-10 injury report and publish per-club counts
rows.why: Round 1 totals disagree with its own text, and Cincinnati is unresolved (RF-13, RF-14).
options: (a) Re-read all eight chunks and publish per-club counts with the capture hash
(b) Keep the round-1 capture unchanged
rows.decision_owner: Next round. It does not block the merge.
